review_comment: Quite likely - the default is MV (false) but this breaks the bitwise logic which was copied over for consistency.

I guess it's safe to assume that there will be at least one valid MappedFieldType, and if the type allows MV it will be set to `false` anyway.
Or maybe there are situations where none of the contexts has a MappedFieldType for that specific field, and in that case we still want to fall back to `false`?
